source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map found; the order is worked out from the photo and from a write-up that says the front nine is on the clubhouse side and the back nine across Presidential Way, with water left on 6, 12, 15 and 16, a dogleg right on 4 and a long pond right on 18. Treat every hole number as a best guess.
unsure.1: The open area north of the clubhouse with scattered bunkers may be the driving range rather than hole 1; traced it as hole 1 because the front nine needs nine greens there.
unsure.3: Traced length (about 330 yd) is well under the card's 464 yd; the back tee may be elsewhere or the hole may be routed differently.
unsure.8: Shares the corridor south of the clubhouse with hole 9; the split between the two is a guess.
unsure.9: Tee placed by the pond south of the 9th green; the fairway here is narrow and the real tee may be elsewhere.
unsure.13: The patch at the top of this fairway could be the 14th tee rather than the 13th green.
unsure.18: Traced about 465 yd against the card's 640 yd; the back tee is probably further south than shown.
